programs.title: Kina \u0026 Yuk
programs.desc: Arctic.Two friendly foxes, Kina and Yuk, get into trouble.While playing, the second animal floats away on an ice floe into the unknown.Kina decides to do everything to find her companion.

programs.title: Open Season
programs.desc: The friendly bear Boguś, raised by humans, leads an idyllic life in the park, where he is a tourist attraction.One day, the teddy bear meets a one-horned deer, the mischievous Elliot, who is persuaded to go on a trip together and gets into trouble.Boguś's guardian decides that it is time for the bear to live in a natural environment.The animal cannot cope outside civilization at all.He can't find his way home either.Moreover, the hunting season is just starting.Carefree Elliot and his helpless companion are now in real danger.Together, they convince the forest inhabitants to join forces and oppose the armed newcomers.

programs.title: The Goldsmith's Secret
programs.desc: 1999. Goldsmith Juan Pablo travels from Spain to New York for an exhibition of his works.On the way he passes through his hometown.He will meet Celia, a great love who changed his life.

programs.title: You're Cordially Invited
programs.desc: A booking error causes two weddings to take place in one place at the same time.Both families face the challenge of having to share space.However, they have no intention of letting anything stop them from organizing a special ceremony for their loved one.Jim (Will Ferrell), the father of Jenni (Geraldine Viswanathan), who is getting ready to marry, and Margot (Reese Witherspoon), sister of the second bride, Neve (Meredith Hagner), try to keep their cool in a difficult situation, but they are still fighting a desperate duel.A comedy directed by Nicholas Stoller, the creator of "Neighbors".

programs.title: Oscar's Eye
programs.desc: Nine-year-old Oscar cannot speak.Because of this, he is rejected and bullied by his peers.However, he becomes friends with the owner of the workshop, Eric, with whom he shares a common passion - photography.

programs.title: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
programs.desc: 23-year-old guitarist Scott Pilgrim (Michael Cera) living in Toronto begins dating seventeen-year-old Knives (Ellen Wong).However, he soon meets the antipathetic Ramona Flowers (Mary Elizabeth Winstead), with whom he immediately falls in love.Regardless of anything, he decides to win the heart of the pink-haired stranger.To do this, he must deal with her seven exes, including:popular actor and skateboarder Lucas Lee (Chris Evans), vegan Todd Ingram (Brandon Routh) with extraordinary powers and musician Matthew Patel (Satya Bhabha).His task is made even more difficult by the rejected Knives, who is desperately trying to get her boyfriend back.The picture is based on the comic book series "Scott Pilgrim" by Canadian artist Bryan Lee O'Malley.The title character was played by Michael Cera, known from "Juno" and "Superbad".
